g.text: V-JEPA-based predictive navigation for indoor PointNav
A Deployment · observe, predict, choose one action, repeat
Initialize every rollout with observed zₜ
Relative coordinate goal gₜ · updated from simulator pose
New RGB observation + updated relative goal · replan after every action
Action set: FORWARD (0.25 m) · TURN_LEFT / TURN_RIGHT (15°) · STOP
Future states are predicted by the model; no future simulator queries, map input or expert path at deployment.
B Training · learn from recorded transitions
Latent loss: prediction vs. frozen next-state target
Motion loss: prediction vs. recorded pose change
Executed action aₜ conditions both heads
Recorded pose changes → local motion targets (training only)
Blue: frozen weights | Orange: learned modules | Dashed border: proposed component / extension
